title: 机械防护
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/126_机械防护.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/126_机械防护/src.py

points.K1: 运动部件伤人：卷入、挤压、剪切、飞出
points.K2: 防护装置是物理屏障，警示带代替不了
points.K3: 防护装置的类型：固定式、联锁式、可调式
points.K4: 防护装置要牢、要全、不添新危害
points.K5: 防护缺失是事故主因：不拆除、常检查
points.K6: 谁能拆、何时拆：培训授权，先上锁挂牌
points.K7: 防卷入：束发扎袖，不戴手套碰旋转件
points.K8: 急停会用，断电后等完全停稳

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台装有透明护罩的台钻旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a bench drill with a clear transparent guard around the chuck, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：机械防护。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣指着皮带护罩和转轴护罩
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a closed belt guard on a motor and a cover over a rotating shaft.
shots.narration: 转动的部件，都要罩起来。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拿螺丝刀准备拆真空泵的皮带护罩
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, his long hair loose and wearing work gloves, holds a screwdriver near the belt guard of a vacuum pump.
shots.narration: 阿杰嫌护罩碍事，想拆了看皮带。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 他的长发和手套离皮带很近
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: long loose hair and a gloved hand very close to a moving belt and pulley, a warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 头发散着，还戴着手套。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老李拦住他，指着护罩
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stops him and points at the belt guard and the switch.
shots.narration: 老李：护罩不能拆，卷进去就晚了！

shots.section_title: 运动部件伤人：卷入、挤压、剪切、飞出
shots.scene: 皮带和皮带轮之间把手卷进去
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand being pulled into the nip point between a belt and a pulley, red arrows, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 第一种，卷入：衣角头发被卷进去。
overlay: 运动部件伤人：卷入、挤压、剪切、飞出

shots.section_title: 运动部件伤人：卷入、挤压、剪切、飞出
shots.scene: 两个部件合拢把手指挤住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two machine parts closing together on a finger, red arrows, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 第二种，挤压：手夹在两件之间。

shots.section_title: 运动部件伤人：卷入、挤压、剪切、飞出
shots.scene: 刀刃类部件剪切手指
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a moving blade passing a fixed edge with a finger near the cutting point, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 第三种，剪切：运动边缘像剪刀。

shots.section_title: 运动部件伤人：卷入、挤压、剪切、飞出
shots.scene: 碎屑和工件从机器飞出伤眼
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: chips and a small part flying out from a rotating machine toward an eye outline, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 还有飞出的碎屑、工件，伤眼伤人。

shots.section_title: 运动部件伤人：卷入、挤压、剪切、飞出
shots.scene: 实验室里的运动部件：离心机、泵皮带、摇床、搅拌器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four lab machines, a centrifuge, a pump belt, an orbital shaker and an overhead stirrer, with rotation arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室里，离心机、泵、摇床都有。

shots.section_title: 运动部件伤人：卷入、挤压、剪切、飞出
shots.scene: 开机前先看清机器的危险点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person looking at a machine with red circles marking its nip point, pinch point and shear point. No text.
shots.narration: 上机前，先看清危险点在哪儿。

shots.section_title: 防护装置是物理屏障，警示带代替不了
shots.scene: 护罩挡在手和皮带之间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solid guard standing between a hand and a moving belt, the hand stopped by the guard. No text.
shots.narration: 防护装置，是人和危险之间的屏障。
overlay: 防护装置是物理屏障，警示带代替不了

shots.section_title: 防护装置是物理屏障，警示带代替不了
shots.scene: 目的是保护人，不是保护机器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a guard with a shield icon protecting a person, a crossed out icon of the guard protecting only the machine. No text.
shots.narration: 它是为了保护人，不只是护机器。

shots.section_title: 防护装置是物理屏障，警示带代替不了
shots.scene: 制度和规定写在纸上，挡不住手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rule sheet floating in the air next to a moving gear, a hand passing through, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 规定写在纸上，挡不住伸进去的手。

shots.section_title: 防护装置是物理屏障，警示带代替不了
shots.scene: 警示带围着机器，手从下面伸进去
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hazard tape barrier around a machine, a hand reaching under the tape to the moving parts, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 警示带只是提醒，不是防护装置。

shots.section_title: 防护装置是物理屏障，警示带代替不了
shots.scene: 实实在在的护罩打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solid metal guard fully enclosing a gear set with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 实实在在的屏障，才算防护。

shots.section_title: 防护装置的类型：固定式、联锁式、可调式
shots.scene: 【实拍】开机前看固定式防护罩，螺钉齐全，需用工具才能拆（设备断电）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a finger pointing at the screws holding a fixed metal guard over a belt drive on a switched off machine.
shots.narration: 固定式：用工具才能拆下。
overlay: 防护装置的类型：固定式、联锁式、可调式

shots.section_title: 防护装置的类型：固定式、联锁式、可调式
shots.scene: 联锁门一开，机器停转
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a machine with an interlocked guard door; the door opens and the rotation arrow stops with a pause icon. No text.
shots.narration: 联锁式：门一打开，机器就停。

shots.section_title: 防护装置的类型：固定式、联锁式、可调式
shots.scene: 可调式护罩按工件高度调节
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an adjustable guard on a bench drill being lowered by hand to just above the workpiece. No text.
shots.narration: 可调式：按工件位置手动调好。

shots.section_title: 防护装置的类型：固定式、联锁式、可调式
shots.scene: 自调式护罩随工件移动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a self adjusting guard on a saw lifting as the workpiece passes and closing after it. No text.
shots.narration: 还有随工件自动开合的护罩。

shots.section_title: 防护装置的类型：固定式、联锁式、可调式
shots.scene: 国家标准书本
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a national standard book with a guard icon on the cover next to several guard types. No text.
shots.narration: 防护装置的要求，见机械安全国家标准。

shots.section_title: 防护装置要牢、要全、不添新危害
shots.scene: 坚固的护罩牢牢固定在机架上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a strong guard bolted firmly to a machine frame with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 防护要结实，牢牢固定在机器上。
overlay: 防护装置要牢、要全、不添新危害

shots.section_title: 防护装置要牢、要全、不添新危害
shots.scene: 护罩把运动部件完全罩住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a guard covering a belt and both pulleys completely with no gaps, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 要把运动部件全罩住。

shots.section_title: 防护装置要牢、要全、不添新危害
shots.scene: 松垮、留大口子、一碰就碎的护罩打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three crossed out guards, one hanging loose, one with a large gap and one made of cracked brittle material. No text.
shots.narration: 松垮、留大口子、一碰就碎，等于没有。

shots.section_title: 防护装置要牢、要全、不添新危害
shots.scene: 护罩边缘锋利或夹手，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a guard with a sharp edge and a pinch point at its hinge, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 护罩本身不能带来新的危害。

shots.section_title: 防护装置要牢、要全、不添新危害
shots.scene: 透过透明护罩观察，加油不用拆
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person looking through a clear guard window and oiling through a small port without removing the guard. No text.
shots.narration: 好的设计：看得见，加油不用拆。

shots.section_title: 防护缺失是事故主因：不拆除、常检查
shots.scene: 护罩缺失的机器发生事故
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a machine with its guard missing on the floor beside it, an injury warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 机械事故的主因：防护缺失或损坏。
overlay: 防护缺失是事故主因：不拆除、常检查

shots.section_title: 防护缺失是事故主因：不拆除、常检查
shots.scene: 拆下的护罩放在一边，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a removed guard leaning against a wall while the machine runs, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 防护装置不得擅自拆除、停用。

shots.section_title: 防护缺失是事故主因：不拆除、常检查
shots.scene: 维修后护罩装回原位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer refitting a belt guard and tightening its screws after maintenance. No text.
shots.narration: 检修拆下的罩子，必须装回。

shots.section_title: 防护缺失是事故主因：不拆除、常检查
shots.scene: 检查清单：护罩、联锁、急停
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an inspection checklist with three blank rows next to a guard, an interlock and an emergency stop icon. No text.
shots.narration: 定期检查维护，否则防护会失效。

shots.section_title: 防护缺失是事故主因：不拆除、常检查
shots.scene: 联锁开关被胶带短接，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an interlock switch taped over to bypass it, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 短接联锁、绕过防护，严禁。

shots.section_title: 防护缺失是事故主因：不拆除、常检查
shots.scene: 摇床上的瓶子用夹具夹紧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: flasks clamped firmly on an orbital shaker platform, a loose flask crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 摇床上的容器要夹紧，防止甩出。

shots.section_title: 防护缺失是事故主因：不拆除、常检查
shots.scene: 发现护罩损坏，挂牌报修
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damaged guard with a blank out of service tag and a phone call to the lab supervisor. No text.
shots.narration: 防护坏了，停用挂牌报修。

shots.section_title: 谁能拆、何时拆：培训授权，先上锁挂牌
shots.scene: 培训课：护罩怎么用、为什么用
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains students in front of a machine with its guard, pointing at the guard.
shots.narration: 防护装置怎么用、为什么用，要培训。
overlay: 谁能拆、何时拆：培训授权，先上锁挂牌

shots.section_title: 谁能拆、何时拆：培训授权，先上锁挂牌
shots.scene: 只有授权人员拆护罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person with a blank authorization badge removing a guard, a student without a badge crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 什么时候能拆、谁能拆，有规定。

shots.section_title: 谁能拆、何时拆：培训授权，先上锁挂牌
shots.scene: 拆罩前断电上锁挂牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand putting a padlock and a blank tag on a machine isolation switch before removing the guard. No text.
shots.narration: 拆罩检修清卡料，先断电上锁挂牌。

shots.section_title: 谁能拆、何时拆：培训授权，先上锁挂牌
shots.scene: 运行中伸手清卡料，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand reaching into a running machine to clear a jam, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 机器运转时，绝不伸手清卡料。

shots.section_title: 谁能拆、何时拆：培训授权，先上锁挂牌
shots.scene: 拆装方法和授权写进操作规程
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank procedure document with a guard icon and a signature line pinned beside a machine. No text.
shots.narration: 拆装方法和授权，写进操作规程。

shots.section_title: 谁能拆、何时拆：培训授权，先上锁挂牌
shots.scene: 装回护罩、检查后才恢复运行
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a guard refitted, a tick on a checklist, then the padlock removed and the machine restarted. No text.
shots.narration: 装回护罩、确认无误，才恢复运行。

shots.section_title: 防卷入：束发扎袖，不戴手套碰旋转件
shots.scene: 长发被旋转的钻头卷住，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: long loose hair being pulled toward a spinning drill chuck, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 长发、宽袖、围巾，最容易被卷入。
overlay: 防卷入：束发扎袖，不戴手套碰旋转件

shots.section_title: 防卷入：束发扎袖，不戴手套碰旋转件
shots.scene: 【实拍】束起长发、扣紧袖口、摘下首饰和挂绳
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a student tying up long hair, buttoning the cuffs, then removing a bracelet and a lanyard.
shots.narration: 头发束起，袖口扎紧，摘下首饰挂绳。

shots.section_title: 防卷入：束发扎袖，不戴手套碰旋转件
shots.scene: 戴手套碰旋转钻头，手套被卷，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gloved hand near a spinning drill bit, the glove being caught and twisted, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 操作钻床等旋转设备，不戴手套。

shots.section_title: 防卷入：束发扎袖，不戴手套碰旋转件
shots.scene: 送丝轮转动时手指远离
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wire feeder with turning drive rollers and a hand kept away, then the side door closed. No text.
shots.narration: 送丝轮在转，手指远离，送完关门。

shots.section_title: 防卷入：束发扎袖，不戴手套碰旋转件
shots.scene: 运行时站在侧面，手不伸向转轴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person standing to the side of a running motor shaft with hands at their sides. No text.
shots.narration: 运行时站侧面，手不伸向转动处。

shots.section_title: 急停会用，断电后等完全停稳
shots.scene: 【实拍】开机前找到急停按钮并示范按下、旋转复位（设备断电）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand pressing a red mushroom emergency stop button on a switched off machine, then twisting it to reset.
shots.narration: 开机前，先找到急停按钮。
overlay: 急停会用，断电后等完全停稳

shots.section_title: 急停会用，断电后等完全停稳
shots.scene: 出现危险，拍下急停
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand slapping a red emergency stop button while a machine shows danger, the rotation stopping. No text.
shots.narration: 一有危险，立即拍下急停。

shots.section_title: 急停会用，断电后等完全停稳
shots.scene: 急停按钮前堆满纸箱，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: boxes piled in front of an emergency stop button, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 急停前不堆杂物，伸手就能够到。

shots.section_title: 急停会用，断电后等完全停稳
shots.scene: 查清原因后再复位开机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier over a machine, then a hand resetting the emergency stop after a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 查清原因、排除故障，再复位开机。

shots.section_title: 急停会用，断电后等完全停稳
shots.scene: 断电后转子仍在惯性转动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a motor switched off with its rotor still spinning, curved motion lines and a clock icon. No text.
shots.narration: 断电后，转子还会靠惯性转一会儿。

shots.section_title: 急停会用，断电后等完全停稳
shots.scene: 用手按停转轴，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand trying to stop a spinning shaft, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别用手或工具去按停转轴。

shots.section_title: 急停会用，断电后等完全停稳
shots.scene: 等完全停稳再动手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stopped motor with a tick and a hand approaching only after the motion lines disappear. No text.
shots.narration: 等它完全停稳，再动手。

shots.section_title: 设备运动区域不进入
shots.scene: 龙门架在导轨上来回移动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large machine with a gantry sliding back and forth on rails, motion arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 大型设备的龙门架会来回移动。

shots.section_title: 设备运动区域不进入
shots.scene: 人进入运动区被龙门架和管线撞挤，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person stepping into the travel area of a gantry and being caught by moving cables and bellows, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 人走进去，会被撞到、卷住。

shots.section_title: 设备运动区域不进入
shots.scene: 检修通道挂着链条，禁止进入标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chain hanging across a service access with a no entry sign. No text.
shots.narration: 链条挂着，就是不得进入。

shots.section_title: 设备运动区域不进入
shots.scene: 参观人员沿通道走，听从指引
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: visitors walking along a marked aisle beside a large machine, following a guide, staying outside the travel area. No text.
shots.narration: 参观时沿通道走，听从带队指引。

shots.section_title: 设备运动区域不进入
shots.scene: 检修需要进入时先停机上锁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer locking out a machine before stepping into the gantry area. No text.
shots.narration: 确需进入检修，先停机上锁。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 卷入、挤压、剪切、飞出四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a nip point, a pinch point, a shear point and flying chips. No text.
shots.narration: 运动部件会卷、挤、剪、飞。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 护罩、联锁、警示带打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a solid guard with a tick, an interlock with a tick and a hazard tape crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 靠牢靠的防护，不靠警示带。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 不拆罩、束发不戴手套、急停
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a guard in place, tied hair with a crossed out glove and an emergency stop button. No text.
shots.narration: 不拆罩，束发不戴手套，会用急停。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣站在工具墙前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a wall of unplugged hand power tools and a bench grinder with guards and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：手持电动工具与砂轮机。
